_note: Source of truth for the draft battle lines. code -> {line, rename?, target?}. Edit here, then run build.py.

A1.line: %user draws their ninjato in one flat stroke, and a thin blade of chakra peels from the edge and races down the line toward %target. Anything standing in its path is cut clean through the guard.

A2.line: %user stamps down hard and drives chakra through the soles of their sandals. A ring of force cracks outward across the ground, splintering stone and fence posts as it rolls over %target and anyone near them.

A3.line: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

B01.line: %user gathers chakra into one clenched fist until the air around it hums. They cross the distance in a single step and drive the blow into %target with the weight of a falling temple beam.

B02.line: %user sweeps both arms wide and releases a crushing wall of chakra across the field. It tears loose roof tiles and flattens the grass as it breaks over %target and everyone beside them.

B03.line: %user plunges a hand into the earth and twists, turning the ground beneath %target into a dragging current of chakra. Before they can brace, %target is hauled across the battlefield like driftwood in a flood.

B04.line: %user brushes a death sigil onto a paper seal in a single stroke and flings it at %target. The ink sinks into their chakra network and tries to stop it cold. If the seal takes hold, %target falls where they stand.

B05.line: %user lashes out with a coiling hand of chakra that seizes %target by the collar. It strikes hard and does not let go, feeding on their chakra and stamina in the moments that follow.

B06.line: %user weaves the Ram seal and presses chakra into the earth at their side. A second %user rises from it, identical down to the dust on their tabi, and steps into the fight.

B07.line: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

B08.line: %user sounds a low chime of chakra that settles over %target like river fog. Every motion %target makes begins to drag, and each technique costs them more effort to complete.

B09.line: %user lets their breathing fall silent and slips behind a veil of chakra. Their outline thins like smoke from a snuffed lantern until nothing is left to strike.

B10.line: %user forms the Tiger seal and floods every chakra point in their body at once. Their strikes grow heavier and their stance turns to iron, the bearing of a warlord who has no intention of falling.

B11.line: %user presses a burning curse mark onto %target, and black script crawls across their skin. The brand seals away their bloodline, leaves them open to every blow, and keeps searing as further hits land.

B12.line: %user traces a slow spiral of dark chakra and casts it over %target like a funeral shroud. Their strikes lose their bite, and their wounds refuse to close.

B13.line: %user flicks out threads of hostile chakra that lash around %target and bite into their skin. The weave saps their strength, slows their recovery, and leaves them easier to wound.

B14.line: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

B15.line: %user drives their palm into the ground, and jagged spines of chakra erupt beneath %target. Each spine that pierces them drinks deeply, draining their chakra and stamina away.

B16.line: %user hurls chains of chakra that wrap %target from shoulder to ankle and crush tight. The bindings leave them stunned and seal away their bloodline while the links hold.

B17.line: %user claps their hands together, and chakra rings out like a struck temple bell. The shockwave rolls over %target and everyone around them, leaving them reeling and unable to act.

B18.line: %user lets a ravenous surge of chakra loose through their body, and their eyes take on a feral glint. The hunger does not fade, feeding every blow and every movement for the rest of the fight.

B19.line: %user plants their feet and settles their breathing, drawing chakra evenly through every limb. Their strikes come sharper and their guard stands firmer, the poise of a seasoned swordsman.

B20.line: %user opens the gates of their chakra and lets it flow freely through their body. Power floods their limbs, sharpening their strikes and strengthening every movement.

B21.line: %user slows their breathing to the stillness of the hour before dawn and gathers chakra close around them. Blows that land are drawn in and turned into vitality while their next attacks gain an edge.

B22.line: %user folds chakra into overlapping panels like a byobu screen and draws them close around their body. Incoming blows are softened, and part of their force is drawn back in as vitality.

B23.line: %user crosses their arms and hardens a shell of chakra around themselves, bracing like a castle gate. Behind it they gather force for a heavier counterattack.

B24.line: %user slips into shadow beneath a veil of chakra, tending their wounds as they vanish. When they move again, their blows will land harder and the strikes against them softer.

B26.line: %user drives a guarded blow into %target, keeping their stance low and their elbows tight. Chakra hardens along their arms to blunt whatever answer comes back.

B27.line: %user rakes a burning edge of chakra across %target, leaving a wound that smolders like charcoal. The cut keeps bleeding, and every blow that follows sears it hotter.

B28.line: %user slams a chakra-charged palm into %target, infusing them with unstable energy that lashes back whenever they deal damage. The mark pulses beneath their skin, waiting for them to strike.

B29.line: %user hurls a hungry wave of chakra through %target and pulls part of its force back into their own body. For a time, the blows that land on %user are drawn in and turned into vitality.

B30.line: %user draws a deep breath and releases a roar laced with chakra that shakes paper from the shoji. %target and everyone beside them are staggered, their attacks weakened by the force of it.

B31.line: %user spins a widening spiral of chakra over %target and the allies around them. While it turns, their guard steadies and their strikes sharpen.

B32.line: %user forms the Ram seal and releases a cold pulse of chakra across the field. Every enhancement wrapped around %target and those beside them is stripped away in an instant.

B33.line: %user condenses lightning into a slender needle of chakra and drives it straight through %target's defenses. The puncture leaves them exposed to the next assault.

B34.line: %user cuts across %target with a blade of chakra polished bright as a mirror. The edge keeps its shine afterward, ready to turn part of any returning blow back on its sender.

B35.line: %user swings through %target in a reaping arc and draws the spent chakra back along the blade. The stolen strength closes some of their own wounds.

B36.line: %user threads a wasting current of chakra through %target like a needle through silk. The weave wounds them, softens their defenses, and slows their recovery.

B37.line: %user settles into a compact stance, knees bent and weight centered, wasting no motion. Their strikes grow sharper and their guard steadier for a short time.

B38.line: %user coaxes a small surplus of chakra into their muscles. For a few moments their strikes carry more weight and their movements come quicker.

B39.line: %user raises a translucent shell of chakra around themselves, thin as rice paper but tightly woven. It catches the blows meant for them until it breaks.

EA01.line: %user draws a breath, shapes wind chakra into a spearpoint between two fingers, and fires it at %target. The gust strikes with a sharp crack, like a kite string snapping taut.

EA02.line: %user whips a violent gust of wind chakra into %target at close range. The blast strikes hard and hurls them back across the battlefield.

EA03.line: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

EA04.line: %user compresses the air into a narrow spear of wind chakra and drives it straight through %target. The point punches past their guard as if it were not there.

EE01.line: %user pulls splinters of slate from the ground with a twist of chakra and packs them into a single stone. They hurl it at %target with a sharp flick of the wrist.

EE02.line: %user slams both palms down, and the ground beneath %target splits and buckles. Stone surges up around their legs, staggering them and pinning their feet in place.

EE03.line: %user sets their feet and draws a crust of earth chakra across their skin like fired clay. Blows that land on them lose much of their force.

EF01.line: %user exhales a single cinder of fire chakra and flicks it toward %target. It burns white-hot as it flies and bursts against them in a spray of sparks.

EF02.line: %user splits the ground beneath %target with a burning seam of fire chakra. Flame bursts up through the crack and leaves a scorched wound that keeps eating at them.

EF03.line: %user sweeps a rolling wake of embers over %target. The heat settles into their clothes and skin, so every blow that follows burns hotter.

EL01.line: %user draws crackling lightning chakra to a fingertip and releases it in a single bright arc. It snaps across the distance and strikes %target with a burst of white light.

EL02.line: %user drives a fist wrapped in lightning chakra into %target, and thunder cracks on impact. The charge lingers along their own skin, ready to throw part of any returning blow back on its sender.

EL03.line: %user snaps a quick spark of lightning chakra into %target. The jolt locks their muscles and stops them in their tracks for a moment.

EL04.line: %user shapes a concentrated spear of lightning chakra that hisses and spits in their grip. They drive it cleanly through %target, the point piercing every defense in its way.

EW01.line: %user draws water from the air into a dense bead of chakra between their fingers. They flick it at %target, and it strikes with the force of a hurled stone.

EW02.line: %user calls up a surge of water chakra and crashes it into %target at close range. As the wave recedes, it wraps around %user in a protective layer of water.

EW03.line: %user gathers a cool spring of chakra around themselves, like water rising in a well. Blows that strike them are drawn in and turned into vitality.

S01.line: %user plants their feet, twists from the hips, and puts their whole weight behind one heavy strike. It lands on %target with a crack that echoes across the field.

S02.line: %user darts in with a compact strike, quick as a swallow, aimed at an opening in %target's guard. They are back out of reach before the blow fully lands.

S03.line: %user springs across the gap with a burst of chakra in their legs and thrusts a driving attack into %target. The lunge closes the distance in a single heartbeat.

S04.line: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

S06.line: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

S07.line: %user fans a handful of shuriken between their fingers and loosens them in rapid succession. They whistle in at %target from every angle before they can settle their guard.

S08.line: %user flicks a senbon needle, its tip glinting, into a nerve point on %target. The strike can lock their muscles for a moment and leave them staggered.

S27.line: %user lands a precise blow on %target's sword arm, numbing it to the shoulder. Their attacks lose their force for a short time.

S28.line: %user strikes a chakra point on %target with two stiff fingers. Strength drains from their limbs, leaving every technique weaker until it recovers.

S29.line: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

S30.line: %user strikes %target with a hand wreathed in heat, leaving embers smoldering in the folds of their clothing. Every blow that follows burns hotter.

S31.line: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

S32.line: %user strikes %target with chakra that clings to the wound like pine sap. Until it fades, nothing can cleanse the harm laid on them.

S33.line: %user sends a sweeping volley of kunai across the field, and chakra marks bloom wherever they strike. %target and everyone beside them are left exposed to the attacks that follow.

S34.line: %user forms the Snake seal, steadies their breathing, and pushes chakra outward through every pore. Poisons, curses and lingering harm are flushed from their body.

S35.line: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

S36.line: %user takes a disciplined guard and wraps themselves in a tight weave of chakra. For a time, curses and weakening techniques slide off them like rain off oiled paper.

S38.line: %user flicks a swift strike across %target, more feint than blow. It tests their defenses and searches for an opening.

S39.line: %user drives a short, solid blow into %target's side. It lands with a dull thud that rattles their guard.

S40.line: %user measures the distance to %target with a calm eye and delivers a clean, controlled strike. Nothing in the motion is wasted.

S41.line: %user holds their footing and lands a steady, deliberate blow on %target. It is the patient strike of a fighter who has drilled it ten thousand times.

S42.line: %user channels their full weight into a forceful strike against %target. The impact knocks the breath from them.

S43.line: %user draws a heavy cutting arc through %target's defenses, putting their shoulders into the swing. The blade bites deep.

S44.line: %user brings a sundering blow down on %target with chakra packed behind it. The strike lands with enough force to split a wooden gate.
